title: WebCMS Admin Control Panel
instructions: Build a functional admin control panel at /admin with management screens for plugins, pages, posts, media, templates, themes, users, roles, settings, cache, backups, workflows, tenants, search, and notifications. Include backend API endpoints, frontend React components, navigation, and dashboard widgets.

1783837132.0711699.instruction: Create unified admin API module at webcms/admin/api.py with endpoints for: list/create/update/delete pages, posts, media, plugins, templates, themes, users, roles, settings, cache operations, backup trigger, workflow list, tenant list, search analytics, notification queue. Add request/response helpers and admin auth middleware.

log.text: Created webcms/admin/admin_api.py with unified admin API handlers covering dashboard, pages, posts, media, plugins, templates, themes, users, roles, settings, cache, backups, workflows, tenants, search analytics, and notifications. Added register_admin_api() function to wire all routes under /api/v1/admin/*. Verified the module compiles successfully.

1783837134.4620793.instruction: Implement backend dashboard widget system in webcms/admin/widgets.py that returns summary cards for: content counts, pending workflows, cache hit rate, recent backups, plugin status, search queries, notifications, tenant usage. Expose via /api/v1/admin/dashboard endpoint.

log.text: Implemented webcms/admin/widgets.py with 8 dashboard widgets: ContentCountWidget, WorkflowWidget, CacheWidget, BackupWidget, PluginWidget, SearchWidget, NotificationWidget, TenantWidget. Each widget returns structured data for the admin dashboard. Wired /api/v1/admin/dashboard endpoint in admin_api.py to use the widget registry. Added WidgetConfig compatibility alias for existing admin/api.py. Verified with test_admin_dashboard.py showing all 8 widgets render correctly.

1783837136.8881493.instruction: Create webcms/admin-ui/src/admin/AdminShell.jsx with sidebar navigation, top bar with user/profile, breadcrumb, and main content area. Add routes for Dashboard, Content (Pages/Posts), Media, Plugins, Templates, Themes, Users, Settings, Cache, Backups, Workflows, Tenants, Search, Notifications.

log.text: Created webcms/admin-ui/src/admin/AdminShell.jsx with sidebar navigation grouped by Content/Design/Access/Operations, top bar with breadcrumb and profile, and main content area with routes for all 14 admin screens. Added admin.css with responsive layout and widget grid styles. Created stub page components for Dashboard, ContentManager, MediaManager, PluginManager, TemplateManager, ThemeManager, UserManager, Settings, CacheManager, BackupManager, WorkflowManager, TenantManager, SearchManager, and NotificationManager. Verified the admin directory structure.

1783837140.627099.instruction: Create React components for listing, creating, editing, and deleting pages and posts. Include data table with sorting/filtering, editor with markdown preview, status dropdown, publish date picker, author selector, category/tag inputs, and save/publish actions. Connect to admin content API.

log.text: Built Pages & Posts management screens: created DataTable component with sorting/filtering/actions, ContentEditor component with markdown preview, status dropdown, publish date picker, author selector, category/tag inputs, and save/publish buttons. Updated ContentManager with post/page tabs, API integration to /api/v1/admin/posts and /api/v1/admin/pages for list/create/update/delete, and added responsive CSS for tables, tabs, forms, and editor split view.

1783837143.4613008.instruction: Create management screens: Media gallery with upload, delete, bulk select; Plugins list with activate/deactivate/install/uninstall; Templates list with create/edit/delete; Themes list with activate/preview. Connect to corresponding admin API endpoints.

log.text: Created management screens for Media, Plugins, Templates, and Themes: MediaManager with file upload, bulk select/delete; PluginManager with activate/deactivate and uninstall actions; TemplateManager with create/edit/delete and code editor; ThemeManager with activate/preview. All screens connect to /api/v1/admin/media, /plugins, /templates, /themes endpoints. Added supporting CSS for media grid, theme cards, toolbar, and plugin rows.

1783837145.9699597.instruction: Create admin screens for user management (list, create, edit, delete, activate/deactivate), role/permission editor, and global settings editor with forms for site name, URL, email, cache, search, notification, and security settings.

1783837149.0413644.instruction: Create admin screens for cache analytics, warm/invalidate cache, backup list with create/restore/verify, workflow instances list with state transitions and reviewer assignment, and workflow definitions overview.

1783837151.6537328.instruction: Create admin screens for tenant CRUD and analytics, search analytics and suggestions, notification preferences, manual notification send, digest trigger, and email queue stats. Connect to admin API endpoints.

1783837154.1657403.instruction: Register /admin route in backend to serve the React admin UI. Update admin-ui routing to use AdminShell as default /admin layout. Build and verify the full control panel loads, navigation works, and each management screen can fetch and display data from backend APIs.
